edition: Nestle-Aland 28 (NA28); German Bible Society online running text
authorization: User explicitly authorized NA28 provisionally on 15 October 2026; UBS6/ECM review remains pending.
scope: NA28 is the user-authorized provisional New Testament base. Focused checks of the German Bible Society’s Greek running text are recorded by chapter. This is an English editorial revision, not complete critical-text or apparatus verification. The newer Bespoke PDF’s preferred UBS6 text has not been obtained; UBS6/ECM comparison, full apparatus, independent Greek and human read-aloud reviews remain pending.
historical_records: Existing index and reference records were consulted as historical reference, not proof of fresh complete Greek verification.

chapters.decision: Ordinary you and modern verbs restored. The salvation we share renders common salvation naturally. Jesus in 1:5 is retained as the consulted NA28 subject. Keep/kept in 1:6 and the distinct judgment images remain. Michael addresses the devil with you in 1:9; May the Lord rebuke you is a third-person wish, not direct address to God. Without fear in 1:12 now accompanies feasting, following the displayed punctuation. Every soul in 1:15 replaces all the ungodly to follow pasan psychen; the subsequent ungodly/ungodliness repetitions remain. Unspiritual in 1:19 renders psychikoi in its contrast with not having the Spirit. The full doxology in 1:24–25 continues across the existing verse boundary.
chapters.focus: Read all 25 English and displayed Greek verses; focused comparison of Jesus in 1:5, the keep/kept language, Michael’s quoted wish, images in 1:12–13, every soul in 1:15, the mercy/save sequence in 1:22–23 and the complete doxology.
chapters.running_text_read: Displayed NA28 running text read; focused comparison of the recorded features, not an exhaustive apparatus collation.

Review kept for/by Jesus Christ in 1:1, the other-flesh and like-these relation in 1:7, reefs/spots in 1:12, the scope of without fear, psychikoi in 1:19 and doubting/disputing in 1:22.
